'phags pa thogs med kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus yin zhing*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang*/ sangs rgyas 'bangs dang*/ dge 'dun 'bangs rnams kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi dus so/ /slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen tshe ring paur gnas pa de'i slob ma dge 'dun srung ba zhes pa'ang byung la/ dus 'di yan chad du gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la ma dar ba ni ma yin te/ sngon theg pa chen po'i chos dar ba nas mi ring bar byung ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa stong phrag brgya po de dag dang*/ u rgyan gyi yul du skye bo thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa rnams kyang phal cher bla med kyi lam la brten pa yin la/ 'on kyang de dag ni gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pas skal ldan brgya'am stong la sogs pa la cig car du zhal bstan te sngags kyi theg pa bstan/ de dag thams cad 'ja' lus su gyur nas/ de'i rjes su gdams pa bzhag pa'ang med la/ sngon gyi skyes bu rnams shin tu sgom zhing gsang ba srung ba yin pa'i phyir de dag rig pa 'dzin pa ma grub kyi bar du sus kyang gsang sngags spyod pa yin par ma shes te/ gang cho 'phrul chen po dang bcas te mkha' la gshegs pa'am mi snang bar gyur pa na/ kye ma de dag ni sngags kyi spyod pa can yin no zhes slad nas rig par 'gyur ba sha stag go /de'i phyir slob dpon gyis slob ma la brgyud pa'i rim pas 'doms pa'ang cung zad tsam las med la/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi sngags rgyud nyams su len pa ni theg pa chen po dar nas brtsams te shin tu mang ba zhig yod na'ang*/ shin tu gsang zhing spyod pa yin pa'i phyir gsang sngags de nyid la spyod pa yin na ma gtogs ci zhig nyams su len sus kyang mi shes so/ /de'i phyir las dang dngos grub rnams thogs pa med par 'grub pa zhig yod do/ /sa ra ha dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras dang*/

grub thob shā wa ri pa'i bar du brgyud pa nas brgyud par rjes su bzung ba ni/ yongs su grags pa ltar yod par mngon la/ gzhan du de yan chad kyi slob dpon rnams gsang sngags bla med kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa'ang cher ma mthong ngo*/ /spyod bsdus sgron me las khungs su mdzad pa'i pad+ma badz+ra dang*/ kam+pa la pa byung yang*/ dang por ni 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ma byung bar mngon la phyi ma'i lo rgyus ni ma mthong ngo*/ /de bas na bram ze chen po dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bla med kyi bstan bcos yod pa 'di kun las gzhan pa'i sngags bla na med kyi dgongs 'grel yang 'di yan chad du cher med par grags shing*/ bstan bcos de dag kyang dbu ma rig tshogs la sogs pa'i gzhung bzhin du yongs khyab tu grags pa ni ma yin te/ klu'i byang chub rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas brnyes pa de kho na la gtad pas/ phyis rgyal po de wa pā la yab sras kyi dus su dar bar gyur pa yin te/ de'i phyir 'phags skor dang sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor sogs la rgyud thag nye mor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ / dper na bod kyi yang dag snang gi chos dang*/ gter chos rdzun gsob med pa rnams dang 'dra'o/ /dus 'di tsam nas bzung nas bya spyod kyi sngags rgyud rnams lo nyis brgya tsam gyi bar du shin tu dar zhing mngon mtshan du spyod pa byung la/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams ni dngos grub ma thob kyi bar du mngon mtshan du spyod pa med kyang*/ sngon las ches dar bar gyur zhing*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos kyang ci rigs pa mdzad par byung la/ grub thob grags che ba rnams kyang byon te/ skabs der slob dpon rta mchog dang*/ slob dpon chen po lū yi pa dang*/ grub thob tsar+pa ṭi pa rnams kyang byung ste de dag gi lo rgyus gzhan du gsal/

slob dpon ar+ha ta ni rgyal po karma tsan+d+ra'i dus su sdom brtson sde snod gsum 'dzin par gyur pa zhig yin la/ des gter gyi bum pa chen po bsgrubs so/ /mthar gyis grub ste yul wā rā ṇa sīr sa 'og tu rin po che'i bum pa srid du dpag tshad tsam yod pa byung ste dge 'dun khri phrag mang po la 'tsho ba sbyor ba zhig yod pa las/ dus lan cig srung ba byed pa brjed de/ de'i nub mo gnod sbyin rnams kyis brkus te/ nangs par dge 'dun mchod pa'i don du kha phye ba na stong par mthong nas/ dge slong rig sngags mkhan rdzu 'phrul chen po des tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po thams cad kyang bkug ste/ de rnams gzir ba'i de dag gis gnod sbyin rnams bkug ste slar yang gter gyi bum pa gang ngo*/ /lha rnams 'ongs pa'i rtags su sa g.yo ba dang*/ me tog gi char dang*/ dri bzang po zhag bdun gyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa skye bo thams cad la mngon par gyur to/ /tshul des lo bzhi bcur nye ba dge 'dun mchod par byas/ gter gyi bum pa kho rang nyid la snang ba yin gyi gzhan dag gis sa 'bru bar mthong ngo*/ /'phags pa thogs med sku mched kyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgyal po gau ṭa 'phel byed kyi dus dge slong sde snod gsum 'dzin pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la yid dam du byed pa zhig yod pas dus lan cig dge slong gzhan zhig dang gal bzung ba dang gzhung gzug pa dang*/ brgal brtag byed pa'i tshe nga rgyal gyi skyon gyis de la bud med kyi rig pa can 'di zhes smad do/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khyod kyi las 'dis skye ba mang por bud med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang byang chub ma thob gyi bar du khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni nga yin no zhes gsungs so/ /de ni rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyi dus tsam na skye ba blangs pa ni/

bram ze mo pra kā sa shī la zhes pa rab tu gsal ba'i ngang tshul ma zhes pa yin te/ de skye ba dran zhing chung ngu nas mdo sde dang*/ mngon pa'i gzhung lugs dag mthong zhing thos pa tsam gyis rang shes pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rtag tu mchod pa/ dge ba bcu'i lam la ngang gis gnas pa/ byang chub kyi sems stobs su gyur pa zhig ste/ 'di dge slong mar 'dod pa 'khrul pa yin la/ cher skyes pa na/ de rgyal rigs zhig dang 'dus pa las khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa bcas te blo rno ba'i cho ga byas/ cung zad cher skyes pa na yi ge dang rtsis dang*/ brtag pa brgyad dang*/ brda sprod pa dang*/ rtog ge dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ bzo'i gnas rnams dang*/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la sogs pa ma nyid kyis legs par bslabs te shin tu byang zhing gsal par gyur to/ /des rang gi rigs kyi chos dri ba na bu khyod rigs kyi bya ba byed pa'i phyir bskyed pa ma yin te/ dam pa'i chos dar bar bya ba'i phyir bskyed pa yin na/ rab tu byung nas mang du thos pa dang ting nge 'dzin thob par gyis shig /ces gsungs pa ltar rab tu byung nas mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs 'bring gi bya ba'i dus 'da' ba lo gcig tu mdzad nas/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga'i bar du klog pa la brtson par gnas te/ lo re re tshigs su bcad pa 'bum 'bum gyi tshig don thams cad chub par byas/ de ltar thun mong gi sde snod gsum dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal cher ni rtogs par sla yang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i brjod bya ma zlos shing ma 'dzings pa ni rtogs par dka' bar dgongs nas/ de'i don du lhag pa'i lha zhal mthong bar bya'o zhes gcig tu brnags pas/ gong du bshad pa'i slob dpon ar+ha ta de nyid la dbang bskur pa ma nos pas me tog rgyal ba mi pham pa la phog go /dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang*/ dkyil 'khor gang yin mi gsal yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par mngon te/

slob dpon 'dis sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud la brten nas byams pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i phyir ro zhes bla ma pan+ṭi ta gsung*/ de nas gur pa parba ta ste/ gsung rab las kug ku ṭa pā da parba ta/ ri bo bya rkang can du grags pa de'i phug cig tu 'phags pa byams pa bsgrubs te lo gsum du ltas ci yang ma byung bas thugs mug nas phyir thon pas/ brag gi ngos la bya'i tshang bcas snga dro zan 'tshol ba la 'phur ba dang*/ dgongs ka tshang du log yongs pa brag gi ngos la gshog pa reg tsam de byung ba la/ yun ring pas brag zad par gzigs nas nga'i brtson 'grus chung ngo snyam nas slar ldog ste lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ de bzhin du yang thon pa na/ chu thigs kyis brag zad par gzigs/ yang lo gsum bsgrubs te thon pa na/ mi rgan po zhig ras bal 'jam pos lcags 'phyid par byed cing*/ 'di las phra khab byed pa yin/ sngar yang ras bal gyis phyis te lcags zad pa las khab 'di tsam byung ngo*/ /zhes snod cig khab kyis gang ba bstan no/ /yang lo gsum bsgrubs te/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su ltas ma byung bas thugs skyo ste thon nas phyin pas/ grong khyer zhig na khyi mo mi la zug cing za ba/ smad 'bus khyer ba zhig gzigs nas snying rje lhag par skyes te/ 'bu 'di rnams ma bsal na khyi 'di 'chi la/ bsal nas bor na 'bu rnams 'chi bas rang gi lus kyi sha rnams bcad nas der 'bu rnams gzhug par bya'o snyam ste/ a tsin+ta zhes bya ba'i grong khyer nas spu gri blangs/ lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil gteng par bzhag

/spu gris sku'i brla sha nas phral te/ spyan btsum nas 'bu rnams blang bar brtsams pa na/ phyag gis yul ba las ci yang ma rnyed nas spyan phye ba na/ khyi dang 'bu med par rje btsun byams pa mtshan dpe 'od du 'bar ba gzigs nas/ kye ma yab gcig bdag gi skyabs/ /ngal brgyas 'bad kyang 'bras ma mchis/ /ci'i phyir char sprin rgya mtsho'i dpung*/ /gdung bas bsregs te skom tshad 'bab/ /bdag gis de tsam du bsgrubs kyang zhal mi ston pa zhes spyan chab phyung ba'i/ lha yi rgyal po'i char phab kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ /rang gi las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs te ma mthong ba yin gyis/ nga ni rtag tu khyod kyi drung na gnas so/ /sngar rig sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa thams cad da ltar snying rje chen pos rang gi lus kyi sha bcad pa'i dka' ba des sdig sgrib dag ste/ mthong ba yin gsung*/ da ltar phrag par khur la grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams la ston zhig gsung*/ bstan pas gzhan sus kyang ci yang ma mthong*/ chang 'tshong ma zhig gis khyi gu zhig khur bar mthong ba na yang phyis longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung*/ dbul po khur bskyed pas 'tsho ba zhig gis zhabs mgo tsam mthong bas kyang ting nge 'dzin brnyes shing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob bo/ /dus de nyid du slob dpon gyis chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ khyod ci 'dod gsung pa la/ theg pa chen po dar bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ nga'i gos kyi mtha' la 'jus shig gsung*/ 'jus pas de ma thag dga' ldan du sleb/ de la sa sde'i gna' mchan las/ dga' ldan du zla ba drug bzhugs zer ba yod par grags pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig mi lo bco lnga sogs bzhugs par byed pa ci rigs yod kyang*/ rgya bod yongs khyab tu grags pa la mi lo lnga bcu bzhugs zer te/ de yang lo phyed lor brtsis pa yin pas lo nyer lnga'o zhes rgya gar ba rnams gsung*/

der dga' ldan du mgon po mi pham pa las theg pa chen po'i chos ma lus pa mtha' dag gsan te/ mdo sde thams cad kyi don thugs su chud/ byams pa'i chos lnga gsan pa na don tshan re re gsan pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mi 'dra ba re re thob/ slar yang mi'i yul du byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa na gzhan gyis sems shes pa'i mngon shes thogs pa med pa dang*/ zla ba phyed dam zla ba gcig la sogs pas bgrod dgos pa'i thag ring por 'khor dang bcas pas gshegs pa na'ang thun tshod gcig gam nyi ma gcig gis bgrod pa dang dang por byams pa zhal bzigs pa'i dus de tsam gyi lang tsho la gnas te/ dgung lo dgu bcu lhag kyang sngon gyi de kho na bzhin du gnas pa dang*/ sku la mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis rjes mthun tsam du yod pa la sogs pa spyir sa thob pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan mngon gyur du mnga' ba dang*/ khyad par mnal lam du yang rang don yid byed kyi blo med cing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la spyod pa dang*/ shin tu 'jam zhing dul la des pa yang yin la/ grub mtha' ngan pa sun 'byin zhing spyod pa ngan pa tshar gcod pa sogs lhag par rno ba dang*/ thos pas mi ngaum nyid dang ni/ zang zing med par chos sbyin dang*/ zhes sogs kyi longs spyod la spyod bzhin pa sogs rgyu mtshan du mas sa gsum pa brnyes par byed do/ /de yang slob dpon des dang por ma ga dhā'i yul gyi phyogs cig be lu ba na zhes bya ba'i nags su gtsug lag khang mdzad de bzhugs nas slob ma tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa brgyad la theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo dag bkrol zhing bstan pas/ de thams cad kyang bzod pa thob cing skye bo dad pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa mdo sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag byung ste/ gnas de la chos kyi myu gu'i dgon par grags so/ /der byams pa'i chos lnga yang yi ger bkod/

mngon pa kun las btus dang*/ theg pa chen po bsdus pa dang*/ sa sde lnga dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par bshad pa la sogs pa bstan bcos phal cher mdzad/ de nas yul nub phyogs dang nye ba grong khyer sa ga ri zhes bya bar uṣ+ma pu ri zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du rgyal po zab mo'i sbyin bdag byas te phyogs bzhi'i dge slong thams cad 'dus/ der 'phags pa thogs med kyis so so'i blo dang 'tsham par chos mang du bstan te/ nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga brgya tsam bshad cing*/ thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i don la bkod pas theg pa chen po la rigs sad cing mdo sde'i don la blo gros rgyas pa stong phrag brgal ba tsam byung ste de yang sngon theg pa chen po shin tu dar ba las/ phyis dus kyi dbang gis blo gros chung ngur gyur pa dang*/ dgra lan gsum gyis rim pas nyams te/ slob dpon 'di byon pa'i dus kyi thog ma na/ theg pa chen po'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i dge slong mang po yod na'ang theg pa chen po'i mngon pa shes pa ni ye med cing*/ mdo sde re re nas 'don pa dar po yod kyang*/ mdo don ji bzhin du shes pa med pa la gnas der slob dpon nyid slob ma'i mchog brgyad dang bcas pas chos bstan pas/ de ltar gyur pa'i tshe theg pa chen po'i bstan pa bar skabs su nub pa las slar yang dar bar gyur to zhes phyogs kun tu grags so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zab mo'i phyogs de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo kha ton du byed do/ /des bsams pa/ slob dpon 'di ni 'phags pa yin zhing gzhan gyis sems kyang shes so grags na/ de nyid bden na bdag gis kyang 'di'i yon tan bsngags par bya/ gal te mi bden na skye bo rnams bslu bar byed pa yin pas skye bo'i dbus su brgal te dma' dbab par bya'o zhes blon po rnams dang*/ bram ze rnams dang*/

yid brtan pa'i skye bo lnga brgya tsam la bgros te/ pho brang 'khor gyi khyams su skye bo mang po'i dbus su slob dpon 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bsod snyoms dang na bza' phun sum tshogs pa dag phul te/ khyim gyi nang du ma he nag po sa dkar gyis byugs pa sbas/ gser gyi bum pa zhig gi nang du mi gtsang ba sna tshogs blugs/ kha sbrang rtsis bkang ste ras kyi g.yogs pa lag tu thogs nas/ khyim 'di na ci yod/ lag tu thogs pa 'di ci yin dris pas/ ji bzhin du gsungs/ 'di tsam ni lkog gyur shes pa chung ngu la'ang 'byung na/ sems shes sam mi shes snyams nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i tshig la dri ba gsum/ don la dri ba gsum ste drug po yid kyis dris pas/ ji lta ba bzhin lan gsungs nas/ rang bzhin gsum bstan pa la sogs pa de dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos chung ngu re yang mdzad do/ /de la tshig gi dri ba gsum ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba gang gi tshig bla dwags yin dris pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes lan btab pa 'di lung ma bstan pa'i lta bar mi 'gyur ram/ bya shin tu lus che ba dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa zhes dper byas pa'i lus che ba 'di don gang dang sbyor/ ri dang nags tshal gyi mtshan ma ma mthong na/ rgya mtsho dang thag nye'o zhes pa la/ mtshan ma ma mthong ba'i sa mtshams gang la byed ces pa gsum yin pa las/ dang po ni nang stong pa nyid la dgos/ gnyis pa ni dge ba'i las stobs che ba/ gsum pa ni chos mchog chen po'o/ /don la dri ba gsum ni/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa rdzas su yod dam med/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pas gang ngo bo nyid med pa de yang ngo bo nyid med dam/ stong pa nyid kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mi byed par bshad pa'i mi byed mkhan dang*/ mi byed rgyu'i stong nyid gang yin zhes pa la/ dang po la/ kun rdzob tu rdzas su yod/

don dam pa'i rig shes kyi don med/ gnyis pa ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgongs pas/ ngo bo nyid med pa nyid la slar yang ngo bo nyid yod med gnyis su 'byed/ gsum pa la stong pa nyid du byed mkhan gyi stong nyid ni stong nyid kyi rnam pa tsam gyi blo dang*/ des byed tshul sngar yod phyis med pa'i tshul gnyis kar 'gog pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don du lan btab bo/ /der rgyal po dang skye bo'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pas/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po de yang dag par btul nas theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga byed du bcug ste/ re re yang dge slong brgya brgya dge bsnyen la sogs pa dpag tu med do/ /gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gcung dbyig gnyen yang btul ba yin te 'og tu 'chad do/ / de'i tshe lho phyogs yul kriṣ+ṇa rā dzar bram ze bā su nā zhes bya ba byung ste/ des 'phags pa thogs med ces bya ba rgyal ba mi pham pa las lung blangs te/ theg pa chen po slar yang dar bar byed do zhes thos nas bram ze rang nyid 'khor lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor te yul dbus su 'ongs/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten rnams mchod/ lho phyogs kyi bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir slob dpon 'byon par zhus pas/ der slob dpon dang lhan cig gnas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa lhan cig tu gshegs par brtsams pa'i tshe/ bram ze de'i ma nad kyis btab bo zhes pho nya byung ngo*/ /der bram ze myur du sleb par 'dod pa'i sems kyis gdungs pa na/ slob dpon gyis de la bram ze 'dod na myur du sleb par bya'o/ /des kyang de bzhin du mdzod cig /de nas lam du zhugs pas/ nyi ma de nyid kyi nyi ma phyi phred na slob dpon dang*/ bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa yul kṛṣ+ṇa rā dzar slebs/ de yang kṛṣ+ṇa rā dza ni yul tri liṅga'i nang tshan zhig yin la zla ba gsum gyi lam thun tshod gnyis la bgrod pa yin gsung*/

nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul nas/ tshong dpon dha na rak+ṣi ta zhes bya bas spyan drangs pa'i tshe na yang*/ slob dpon dang tshong dpon 'khor dang bcas pas ma ga dhā dang u rgyan gyi yul gyi lam thams cad zhag gcig nyid la bgrod/ yul kṛṣ+ṇa rā dza dang*/ u rgyan gnyis kar du yun ring rab bzhugs shing chos bstan pas skye bo thams cad la theg pa chen po dar bar mdzad cing*/ yul de gnyis kar mchod rten brgya phrag re bzhengs/ lha khang nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhengs/ de rnams su theg chen gyi chos gzhi re re yang btsugs so/ /de bzhin du ma ga dhar yang mchod rten brgya dang*/ chos gzhi nyer lnga btsugs/ lan cig rgya gar mtha' 'khob grong khyer a yo dh+ya dang nye bar rgyal phran zhig la chos ston zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de dang nye ba na gar log gi grong zhig yod pas/ slob dpon chos gsung bzhin pa la gar log rnams kyi dmag byung bas/ chos nyan pa rnams la bzod pa'i khur bskyed cig par gdams nas thams cad mnyam par bzhag pas gnas pa la/ mda' 'phangs pa thams cad kyang rdul du song*/ gar log gi gtso bos slob dpon la ral gri brtegs pas kyang gnod pa med cing*/ ram gri nyid dum bu brgyar chag go /gzhan yang skur pa gtab pa sogs ji tsam byas kyang g.yo ba med par 'dug pas/ de rnams kyang lhag par dad de phyag byas nas song ngo*/ /slob dpon 'dis gzhan gyi bsam pa mkhyen pa'i phyir chos ston pa thams cad slob mas gang mi shes pa dang*/ the tshom yod pa de nyid gsal bar bkral nas ston pa'i phyir/ slob dpon 'di las chos nyan pa la mkhas par ma gyur pa cung zad kyang med do/ /dus de'i tshe theg pa chen po phal cher gyis mdo sde sna re tsam ma zhus pa med pa lta bu yin zhing*/ slob dpon nyid kyi bdag rkyen kyis chos gzhi brgya tham pa btsugs pa las/ re re la yang blau sbyong ba nyis brgya re nyung mtha' rnams la'ang yod pas/

spyir chos nyan pa'i slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med cing*/ thams cad kyang mchog tu gus pas grub pa'i mtha' yang de ltar 'dzin la/ sa thob pa'i yon tan skyes pa dang*/ sbyor lam gyi yon tan skyes pa sogs stong phrag mang po yang byung zhing*/ mdo sde dang grub mtha' phyogs re tsam ma yin par sgo thams cad nas gsungs shing*/ nyan thos rnams kyang dus de nyid du lhag par gus par byed cing*/ nyan thos rnams nyid kyi mngon pa dang*/ mdo sde nyan par byed pa yang mang du byung ngo*/ /gan+dha ri'i ri sngags grub pas dga' ldan gyi gnas su phyin zhing*/ thag ring po yang yud kyis bgrod par byed/ rtog byed kyi rig sngags grub pas pha rol kyi sems shes pa yin te/ tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa/ rig sngags grub pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che ste/ gzhan du na theg pa chen po la zhugs pa 'di kho na skyon no zhes zer bar grags so/ /de yang sngon theg pa chen po'i chos shin tu dar ba'i tshe yang theg chen gyi dge slong khri phrag tu longs pa ni med/ klu sgrub kyi tshe yang dge 'dun phal cher nyan thos yin no/ /slob dpon 'di'i dus theg chen gyi dge slong khri phrag mang po byung ba sogs rgyu mtshan de rnams kyi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag po yin no zhes grags so/ /'on te slob dpon nyid dang lhan cig gnas pa'i slob ma ni dge slong nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam las med de/ de dag thams cad tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ sde snod 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i lha la the tshom gcod cing bzod pa thob pa sha stag go /sku tshe'i smad kyi dus na nā len+d+rar lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ dgun gyi dus nyin re bzhin mu stegs rgol ba re yong ba la grub mtha' rnams rigs pa sna tshogs kyis sun phyung ste chos bstan pas mu stegs stong du nye ba tsam rab tu byung*/ gtsug lag khang gang na dge slong lta ba dang*/

tshul khrims dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ cho ga nyams pa thams cad chos bzhin tshar gcod par mdzad pas dge 'dun shin tu dag par mdzad do/ /mthar grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu sku 'das te/ de'i shul du slob ma rnams kyis mchod rten byas so/ /gcung dbyig gnyen ni/ bod na 'ga' zhig 'phags pa thogs med kyis mtshe ma'i sku mched du 'dod pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig chos kyi sku mched du 'dod pa snang na'ang*/ 'phags yul mkhas pa la de ltar ma grags te/ 'di'i yab tu gyur pa ni bram ze rig byed gsum dang ldan pa zhig yin la/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med rab tu byung ba'i phyi de'i lor 'khrungs te/ slob dpon 'di gnyis yum gcig pa'i sku mched do/ /blo rno ba'i cho ga byas pa nas mang du thos pa dang ting nge 'dzin thob par gyis shig pa'i bar gcen thogs med kyi skabs dang 'dra/ der dpal nā len+d+rar rab tu byung nas nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum mtha' dag byang bar bslabs/ da dung chos mngon pa'i mtha' rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ sde ba bco brgyad kyi grub mtha' nges pa'i phyir dang*/ rig pa'i lam mtha' dag rtogs pa'i phyir du/ kha cher byon nas slob dpon saṅgha bha dra gtso bor brten/ bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi bstan bcos so so dang*/ sde pa so so'i mdo sde 'dul ba mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams dang*/ mu stegs can lta ba drug po rnams kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag dang*/ rtog ge'i tshul mtha' dag la byang zhing mkhas par byas nas/ yul de nyid du yang lo mang por rigs pa dang mi rigs pa rnam par phye zhing nyan thos kyi sde snod rnams bshad/ slar yul dbus su byon pa'i lam du chom rkun dang*/ lam gyi gnod sbyin la sogs pas lam dgag ma nus par ma ga dhār byon/ der yang lo 'ga' zhig tu nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mang po la rab tu rig pa dang ldan pa'i chos mang po ston zhing bzhugs/

de'i tshe 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'i glegs bam gzigs pas theg chen thugs su ma chud cing*/ lhag pa'i lha la gsan pa la thugs yid ma ches nas/ kye ma thogs med nags su lo/ /bcu gnyis bar du ting 'dzin bsgrubs/ ting 'dzin ma grub glang chen gyi/ rgyab khal longs pa'i grub mtha' brtsams/ zhes gsungs par grags la/ gang ltar yang cung zad bsting tshig tu mdzad pas/ de gcen po 'phags pas gsan te 'dul ba'i dus yin par dgongs te/ dge slong gcig ni blo gros mi bzad pas bstan pa'i mdo 'dzin du bcug

gzhan zhig ni sa bcu pa'i mdo 'dzin du bcug byang ba na thog mar blo gros mi zad pa thon/ de nas sa bcu pa thon cig ces gsungs nas gcung gi drung du btang bas/ de gnyis kyis kyang srod la blo gros mi zad pa bton pas/ theg chen 'di rgyu la bzang ste/ 'bras bu la g.yel lam dgongs/ tho rangs sa bcu pa bton pas/ rgyu 'bras gnyis kar bzang ba la skur pa btab pas sdig pa chen po bsags/ skur pa btab pa'i lce bcad par bya'o dgongs te/ spu gri btsal bas/ dge slong de gnyis na re/ 'di'i don du ljags bcad par ga la 'tshal/ sdig pa bshags pa'i thabs gcen la mnga' bas 'phags pa'i drung du gshegs par zhu byas nas/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi drung du byon/ de nas bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na/ theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag gzigs nas/ sku mched chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa'i tshe gcung spobs pa myur zhing*/ gcen spobs pa mi myur yang lan bzang po byung bas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ yi dam la dris nas lan 'debs gsung*/ gcung gis kyang zhal ston par zhus pas/ da res skal ba med gsungs nas sdig sbyong gi thabs bstan zhes grags mod kyang rgya gar ba'i ngag sgros ji bzhin du mi snang zhing*/ rig pas kyang mi 'thad par mngon te/ 'phags pa thogs med la theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams gsan nas/ bla ma la rtsod pa byed pa dang*/ bla ma la ma zhus par dpe bltas nas rtsal bshad byed pa gnyis kar yang sngon dus bzang po'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa la med cing*/ 'dus bzang la yang slob dpon dang rtsod pa mi byed ces gsung par 'dod bzhin du 'phags pa thogs med la rtsod par 'dod pa ga la 'thad/ thogs med kyis byams pa las lung blangs pa thams cad la grags bzhin/ dbyig gnyen gyis de ltar ma mkhyen par dris pa'i tshul dang*/ yi dam gyi lha zhig la zhu'o zhes thogs med kyis kyang gcung la sbas tshul du gsungs pa de kun 'thad kyang mi 'dra'o/

/des na rgya gar gyi lo rgyus las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sngar gyi 'phro de las brtsams te/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs zhus pas 'phags pas rgyal ba mi pham pa la zhus nas/ khyod kyis theg pa chen po'i chos rgya cher shod/ mdo sde mang po la 'grel pa gyis/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rig sngags 'bum du zlos shig ces gsungs pas/ gcen la theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mtha' dag tshar gcig gsan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/ slob dpon sngags mkhan zhig las sngags kyi 'jug sgo mnos nas/ gzungs mdo lnga brgya bklags/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i rig sngags bzlas pas grub/ yang dag pa'i don thugs su chud cing*/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can mnga' bar gyur/ de'i tshe rgyal ba'i bka' mi yul na bzhugs pa mtha' dag thugs su chud pas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og rol tu slob dpon dbyig gnyen lta bu'i mang du thos pa ni 'ga' yang med do zhes grags so/ /de la nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum las mdo lnga brgya sh+lo ka 'bum phrag gsum/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'dus pa zhe dgu gcig tu bsdoms/ phal po che dang*/ 'dus pa rin po che yang re rer bgrangs/ lhag ma sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde che chung kun bsdoms pa lnga brgya dang*/ bzung sngags lnga brgya ste/ de dag thams cad tshig don ma lus pa thugs su bzhugs so/ /lo re'i nang du lan re zhal 'don du mdzad de/ til mar gyi rdzing bu'i nang du zhugs nas nyin mtshan sprail ma bco lngas de rnams tshar gcig zhal 'don du grub par mdzad cing*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa nyin re bzhin 'don par mdzad pa yang chu tshod gcig gnyis tsam re la grub par mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i tshe nyan thos kyi sde snod 'dzin pa sogs mkhas pa lnga brgya tsam theg chen la zhugs shing*/ 'phags pa thogs med sku 'das pa'i 'og tu dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad de/

chos kyi rnam grangs du ma bton par mdzad pa las/ nyin re bzhin mos pa tha dad pa rnams kyi ngor rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gzhan la gtod pa dang*/ rang nyid kyis rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge slong gi mkhan po dang slob dpon du mdzad pa dang*/ so so'i ltung ba phyir 'chos su 'jug pa dang*/ bdag nyid chos spyod bcu ma chag par mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan stong phrag re nyin rer chos spyod bcu tshang ba la sbyor ba dang*/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mi 'dra ba'i chos thun nyi shu re chag med du gsung pa dang*/ srod kyi dus su chos rnams kyi snying po bsdus te gal bzung ba dang*/ gzhung gzug par mdzad cing*/ gung thun la cung zad tsam mnal ba'i ngang la lhag pa'i lha las chos gsan par mdzad/ tho rangs yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog bar bar du bstan bcos rtsom pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi rgol pa zlog par mdzad de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi khri lnga stong pa dang*/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang*/ sa bcu pa dang*/ dkon mchog rjes dran dang*/ phyag rgya lnga'i mdo dang*/ rten 'brel gyi mdo dang*/ mdo rgyan dang*/ 'byed gnyis sogs theg pa che chung gi mdo sde che chung*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos sogs la gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa lnga bcu tsam dang*/ rang rkang du pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad mdzad/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal 'bum bzlas pas kyang de'i rig sngags grub/ de nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal mngon gsum du gzigs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa brnyes so/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i rten 'brel mdo 'grel sogs gzhan 'grel gsum po pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la bgrang ba phyogs 'dir spyi khyab tu grags kyang*/ tshig 'grel la rab tu byed pa'i tha snyad mi sbyor zhing*/ rnam bshad rig pa la'ang rab tu byed pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa dka'o/ /de la rab tu byed pa ni don tshan gtso che ba re re ston pa'i bstan bcos thor bu'i ming yin pas/

mdo sde rgyan lta bu'i gzhung chen po la'ang mi zer na/ de'i tshig 'grel la zer ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rab tu byed pa sde brgyad las la la la rab tu byed pa'i ming yod la/ 'ga' zhig la med pa'ang mi rigs so/ /slob dpon 'dis mtha' 'khob thag ring po rnams su ma gshegs/ phal cher ma ga dhā nyid du bzhugs/ der chos gzhi rnying pa rnams cung zad zhig pa gso ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi gsar pa brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs te ma ga dhā'i sa phyogs thams cad chos gzhis khyab par mdzad/ shar phyogs gau ri'i yul du lan cig byon/ der grong khyer gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la mdo sde mang po gsungs pas/ lha rnams kyis gser gyi me tog gi char phab/ mu to ba re res kyang gser gyi me tog bre bo che re re tsam rnyed pa byung*/ yul der yang chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs so/ /o ṭi bi shar bram ze mak+ṣi ka zhes bya bas spyan drangs te/ der theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun stong phrag bcu gnyis la zla ba gsum du dus ston byas pas/ bram ze'i khyim du rin po che'i 'byung khungs lnga brdol/ yul de yang bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag dang*/ rgyal po rnams dad par byas nas/ der yang chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs so/ /gzhan yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud la sogs pa mang por yang slob dpon nyid kyis bka' bsgos te chos gzhi btsugs pa thams cad bsdoms na de dang mnyam pa tsam yod pas/ chos gzhi drug brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi tshugs so zhes grags so/ /slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi dus las kyang theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun 'di skabs mang ste/ yul thams cad kyi rnams bsdoms na theg pa chen po'i dge slong drug khri longs pa tsam yod skad/ slob dpon nyid dang lhan cig tu rgyu zhing gnas pa'i dge slong yang stong tsam ste de thams cad tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa sha stag go

/ slob dpon de nyid gang du bzhugs pa thams cad du mi ma yin gyi mchod pa'i yo byad 'byung ba dang*/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs brdol ba sogs ya mtshan gyi chos rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ngo*/ /bsam na shes pa'i mngon shes kyis dge mi dge dris pa thams cad bden par lung ston/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer la me shor ba bden stobs brjod pas zhi ba dang*/ grong khyer mthar skyes su nad rims byung ba'am bden stobs brjod pas zhi ba dang*/ rig sngags kyis mthus sku che la dbang thob pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig go /snga phyir mu stegs kyi rgol ba lnga brgya tsam sun phyung zhing*/ spyir bram ze dang mu stegs can stong phrag lnga tsam sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcugamathar slob dpon stong gis bskor nas bal yul du byon te/ der yang chos gzhi btsugs te dge 'dun mang po thug med du 'phel bar mdzad/ khyim btsun chos gos gyon nas zhing rmo ba gzigs nas/ ston pa'i bstan pa nyams so zhes thugs 'byung nas/ dge 'dun gyi dbus su chos bstan te/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs mgo zhabs bzlog pa lan gsum zlos pas de nyid du sku 'das te re zhig chos kyi nyi ma nub bo zhes grags so/ /der slob ma rnams kyis mchod rten yang byas so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na mngon pa mdzod rtsa ba brtsams nas kha cher 'dus bzang la bskur bas dgyes shing 'grel pa gzigs phul bas ma dgyes te/ rtsod pa'i don du ma ga dhār byon pa la/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis bal yul du byon pa yin no zhes zer ba/ mdzod rtsa 'grel brtsams nas 'dus bzang la gzigs phul bas dgyes pa dang*/ ma dgyes pa sogs de ltar 'thad du rung la/ 'dus bzang ma ga dhar byon pa'i gtam gsal po rgya gar na med cing*/ byon du zin na'ang snga mor yin par mngon nas/ dbyig gnyen bal yul du byon pa'i dus na/

'dus bzang sku 'das nas lo mang por lon par mngon no/ /de la slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rab tu byung nas chos kyi bya ba lo bdun cu rtsa lnga tsam mdzad/ lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /gsungs pa'i lung bstan pa'i lo ni phyed yin zhing*/ chos kyis 'tsho ba'i dbang du mdzad pa dang 'grig lo sum cu lhag cig 'gro don nges par mdzad la/ rgya gar ba kha cig bzhi bcu lhag par mdzad par 'dod pa'i lugs kyang snang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis dgung lo brgyar nye ba tsam bzhugs shing*/ 'phags pa thogs med bzhugs pa'i dus nyid du'ang lo mang por 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ 'phags pa'i rjes su lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /slob dpon chen po 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po lha tho ri gnyan btsan dus mnyam mo zhes grags pa ltar yang 'thad do/ /'phags pa thogs med sku mched kyi dus su byung ba'i gtam ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyi sku tshe'i smad tsam gyi dus na/ rgyal po zab mo'i phyogs 'das pa'i 'og tu nub phyogs ma ru'i yul du skyes pa rgyal bo shrī har+sha zhes bya ba las kyi stobs shin tu che ba byung ste nub phyogs kyi rgyal khams thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa thob ste slob dpon yon tan 'od bla mar bkur ba zhig byung*/ dus de tsam na shar phyogs su rgyal bo bṛk+ṣa tsan+d+ra'i bu brgyud la rgyal po bi ga ma tsan+d+ra dang*/ de'i bu kā ma tsan+d+ra gnyis kyis rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus te/ rgyal po de gnyis dbang thang dang longs spyod kyang che/ sbyin pa la dga'/ rgyal srid chos lugs bzhin du skyong ba yin kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ste/ phyi nang gnyis kar mchod cing khyad par gcer bu pa rnams la mos so/ kha cher de tsam na yang rgyal po mang pos bkur ba nyid yod do zhes grags so/

/de'i tshe shar phyogs su slob dpon blo gros brtan pa dang*/ phyogs kyi glang pos 'gro don mdzad/ nub phyogs su 'phags pa thogs med kyi slob ma sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi sku tshe'i smad kyi 'gro don dang*/ yon tan 'od kyi 'gro don dar ba'i dus so/ kha che'i yul du btsun pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyis 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ slob dpon chos 'bangs yul thams cad du gshegs shing chos ston pa zhig byung la/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs byon/ legs ldan dang*/ rnam grol sde gnyis kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi dus tsam yin/ o ṭi bi sha'i yul du rgyal po dza le ru he'i bu nā ge sha dang*/ blon po bram ze nā ga ke sha zhes bya ba byung ste/ lo bdun tsam rgyal srid bskyangs pas shin tu dbang thang che zhing*/ bi kha ma tsan+d+ras kyang phyag byas/ slob dpon lo yi pas btul te rgyal srid spangs/ grub pa thob pa ni rgyal po da ri ka pa dang*/ blon po ḍeṃ gi pa'o/ /slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs zhes pa'ang legs ldan dang dus mnyam pa tsam yin zhing*/ o ḍi bi shar bram ze bha dra pā li ta zhes bya ba'i kyang bstan pa la bya ba cher byas so/ /de dag las/ rgyal po shrī har+sha 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe kla klo'i chos rnams nub par 'dod pas/ yul mau la ta na dang nye ba'i yul phran zhig tu ma si ta ste kla klo'i dgon gnas chen po shing khang 'ba' zhig yin pa brtsigs nas kla klo'i ston pa mtha' dag bos/ zla ba mang por yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs/ de'i ring lugs kyi glegs bam thams cad kyang bsdus/ thams cad me la bsregs pas kla klo'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa stong phrag bcu gnyis tshig go /de skabs yul kho rā sa ṇar kla klo'i chos shes pa gcig thags 'thag cing yod do/ /de las rim gyis mched pa ni phyis kyi kla klo thams cad yin no/

/rgyal po des de ltar bsnubs pa la brten te lo brgyar nye bar stag gzig sog po'i chos lugs de spyod pa shin tu nyung ngo*/ /de nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i don du ma ru dang*/ ma la wa dang*/ me wa ra dang*/ pi tu wa dang*/ tsi tā wa ra zhes pa'i yul rnams su gtsug lag khang chen po re re bzhengs/ dge slong stong phrag re re'i 'tsho ba sbyar zhing chos shin tu dar bar byas so/ /slob dpon chen po yon tan 'od ni/ yul bcom brlag tu bram ze'i rigs su skyes/ rig byed dang bstan bcos mtha' dag legs par byang ba phyis de nyid kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyi drung du nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma la yang mkhas par sbyangs/ sde pa tha dad pa'i 'dul ba bstan bcos dang bcas pa mtha' dag mkhas par mkhyen/ 'dul ba 'bum ste rtag tu thugs la 'don par mdzad/ yul bcom brlag gi gtsug lag khang a gra pu ri zhes bya bar bzhugs te/ lhan cig gnas pa dge slong stong phrag lnga re yod cing*/ thams cad kyang bsdam bya'i nyes byas phra mo tshun chod so so'i phyir bcos kyis 'phral 'phral du bcos pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni sngon dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bstan pa skyong ba'i dus bzhin yod la/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dang*/ ma mo 'dzin pa'ang mang du yod cing*/ 'dul ba 'bum sde thon pa'ang lnga brgya tsam mo/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis rgyal po shrī har+sha'i blon po ma taṅga rā dza zhes bya ba lan cig rgyal po'i chad pas mig phyung ba yang slob dpon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis sor chud/ rgyal po'i bla mar gyur pas nyin re bzhin yo byad dpag tu med pa'i 'du ba byung yang de ma thag thams cad dge bar bsgyur te/ rang nyid sbyangs pa'i yon tan las nyams pa mi mnga' 'o/ /slob dpon blo gros brtan pa ni/

slob dpon dbyig gnyen 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgur grags pa'i gsung rab rnams zhal 'don mdzad pa'i tshe/ gdung gi phrag na phug ron cang shes pa zhig gnas pa shin tu gus pas nyan no/ /de shi nas lho phyogs dan+ṭa ka ra n+ya zhes bya bar tshong dpon gyi bu zhig tu skyes/ skyes ma thag tu slob dpon ga na bzhugs dris pa la/ slob dpon su yin dris pas/ dbyig gnyen yin te ma ga dhā na bzhugs zer/ yul de'i tshong pa la dris pas kyang bzhugs zer bas/ lo bdun lon pa'i dus na slob dpon dbyig gnyen drung du bskyal te rig pa slob cing yod pas kyang dka' ba med par shes/ de'i tshe sran ma sbar gang rnyed pa za'am snyam nas sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig na yod pa la/ 'phags ma la ma phul bar bza' mi rung snyam nas sran ma 'ga' zhig phul bas 'gril nas byung*/ 'phags mas ma gsol bar rang za ba mi 'ong snyam nas/ zad zad phul yang 'gril te byung ba na/ byis par gyur pas ngus so/ /'phags mas zhal mngon sum du bstan te/ khyod ma ngu zhig ngas byin gyis rlob bo zhes gsungs/ skad cig de la blo gros mtha' yas par gyur zhing/ sku brnyan de la yang ma ṣa tā ra zhes grags so/ /phyis gnas brtan sde snod gsum 'dzin pa khyad par du theg pa che chung gi mngon pa mtha' dag la mkhas pa 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa la zhal 'don mdzad pa/ bya ba thams cad 'phags ma sgrol mas lung ston pa zhig ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'dus pa zhe dgu dang dbu ma rtsa ba la 'grel pa yang mdzad/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen sku 'das tsam na/ mu stegs beṣ+ta bā la la sogs pa rgol ba mang po tshar bcad de smra ba'i dbang phyug tu grags/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa phal cher 'grel bshad dang*/ gzhung la 'grel pa yang mang du mdzad do/ /mngon pa mdzod la'ang 'grel pa mdzad zer te/ slob dpon 'di nyid yin min mi shes so/ /slob dpon snga ma rnams kyi dus su btsugs pa'i chos gzhi rnams de tsam na cher med pas/

slob dpon 'dis kyang chos gzhi brgya rtsa btsugs so zhes kyang grags so/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po ni/ lho phyogs grong khyer siṅga bak+ta zhes bya ba kañtsi'i yul dang nye ba zhig tu bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs shing*/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la shin tu mkhas par byas pa zhig gnas ma bu'i sde pa'i mkhan po sde pa de nyid kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa nā ga dat+ta ste glang po byin zhes bya ba las rab tu byung zhing nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum la mkhas par byas nas/ mkhan po de nyid la gdams ngag zhus pas/ brjod du med pa'i bdag 'tshol ba'i gdams pa byin no/ /der rnam par brtags shing btsal na yod par ma mthong ste/ nyin mo skar khung thams cad bsal/ mtshan mo phyogs bzhir mar me btang ste/ lus gcer bur phyung nas phyi nang kun tu yang bltas so/ /de ltar byed pa grogs kyis mthong nas mkhan po la bshad pas mkhan pos kyang dris pa na/ bdag ni blo rtul zhing blo gros dman pas mkhan pos bstan pa'i de nyid gang yin pa de ni bdag gis mi mthong ste/ de'i phyir sgrib byed kyis bsgribs sam snyam de ltar byas nas blta ba yin zer/ don gyis de 'gog par byed pa'i rig pa rnams kyang bstan pas/ mkhan po khros te/ kho bo'i grub mtha' la zur za ba khyod ma 'dug cig ces skrod pa'i gnas ma yin par bskrad pa na/ de nyid du rig pas sun dbyung bar nus mod kyis/ 'os ma yin pas phyag btsal nas phyir byon/ mthar gyis slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du gshegs/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' dag gsan/ mthar mdo lnga brgya tsam bzung bar grags te theg pa che chung dang*/ gzungs sngags tshun chad bsdoms pa'o/ khyad par du sngags mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig las rig sngags nos te bsgrubs pas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pas ji ltar bzhed pa na chos gsan par mdzad do/

/o ḍi bi sha'i yul nags tshal shin tu dben pa'i phyogs gcig bho ta sail zhes bya ba'i brag ri'i phug tu bzhugs/ rtse gcig tu bsam gtan la rtsol bar mdzad do/ /lo 'ga' zhig 'das pa na/ dpal nā len+d+rar mu stegs kyi rtsod pa cher byung*/ der bram ze su dur dza ya zhes bya ba rang gis bsgrubs pa'i lha mngon sum mthong ba rtog ge la shin tu byang ba thub par dka' ba zhig kyang 'dus te/ der sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis rtsod par ma nus nas/ shar phyogs nas slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po spyan drangs so/ /mu stegs de lan gsum du pham par byas shing*/ der 'tshogs pa'i mu stegs kyi rgol ba thams cad kyang re re nas sun phyung*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ gnas der dge 'dun rnams la mdo sde du ma rnam par bshad cing*/ chos mngon pa yang rgyas par byas/ rnam rig dang rtog ge'i bstan bcos thor bu yang mang du mdzad de/ yongs su bsdoms pa la bstan bcos brgya rtsa mdzad par grags/ slar yang o ṭi bi sha'i yul du gshegs nas bsam gtan la brtson par mdzad do/ /der rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i blau gros kyi mthu las byung ba rtog ge'i tshul lugs 'di la sngar brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnams 'thor ba bzhin du gyur pas gcig tu bya bar dgongs te/ tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod dam bca'/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshad ma bsgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las/ /btus te sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes rdo thal gyis bris pas/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ phyogs kun tu snang bas khyab pa dang*/ sgra chen po grags par gyur/ der bram ze nag po zhes bya bas de lta bu'i ltas yin par shes te/ slob dpon bsod snyoms la bzhud pa'i shul du des 'ongs te bsubs/ de ltar lan gnyis su bsubs pas lan gsum pa bris pas/ 'di ku re dang kyal ka'i phyir bsub pa yin na dgos pa chen po yod pas ma bsub cig

/gal te don nor te rtsod par 'dod na lus snang bar gyis zhes pa bris te/ yang bsod snyoms la gshegs pa'i shul du bsub tu 'ongs pas yi ge mthong nas bsdad do/ /der slob dpon 'khor nas/ bstan pa dpang du btsugs te brtsad pas lan mang por mu stegs pham par byas pas/ da khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhugs shig byas pa na/ des sngags bzlas pa'i thal ba gtor bas slob dpon gyi yo byad rnams tshigaslob dpon yang tshig la khad par byung ste/ mu stegs de phyir song ngo*/ /bdag gis 'di cig pu'i don yang mi nus na gzhan gyi don ga la nus snyam du sems bskyed gtong bar brtsams pa na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal mngon sum du byon te/ bu ma byed ma byed skye bo dman dang 'phrad las blau gros ngan skye ste/ /khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di la mu stegs tshogs kyis gnod mi nus par shes/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas ma thob bar du dge ba'i bshes su nga 'gyur gyi/ /phyi ma'i dus su bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ bzod dka'i sdug bsngal du ma dang ldan brnag dka' la/ /sems kyang dam pa min pa'i spyod pa la dga' zhing*/ /skye bo dam pa 'phrad dka' gal te khyod kyi zhal mthong yang*/ /bdag la byin gyis ma brlabs de la ci bgyir mchi/ /zhes zhus pas/ bu khyod ma dga' bar ma byed cig /nyam nga ba thams cad las bdag gis bsrung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bstan bcos de yang legs par brtsams/ lan cig cung snyung bar gyur te/ grong khyer nas bsod snyoms bslangs te nags mthong zhig tu bzhugs pas yur te mnal du song*/ mnal lam du sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal mthong zhing ting nge 'dzin mang po thob/ phyi rol tu lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/ nags kyi me tog rnams kyang 'dud par gyur/ glang po che rnams bsil grib tu byed cing yod pa las yul gyi rgyal po skye bo'i 'khor dang bcas pa skyo sangs la 'ongs pas mthong ste/

ngo mtshar skyes nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pas mnal sad de/ khyod phyogs kyi glang po yin nam dris pas/ de ltar 'dogs gsungs/ der rgyal pos zhabs la phyag byas/ de nas mthar lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/ yul tha dad kyi mu stegs kyi rgol ba phal cher tshar bcad de/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis btsugs pa'i chos gzhi nyams pa phal cher sor chud par mdzad/ slar yang o ḍo bi sha'i rgyal po'i blon po bha dra pā li ta zhes bya ba rgyal po'i mdzod kyi spyan pa yin pa de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug ste/ bram ze des gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug bzhengs/ de re rer dge 'dun gyi sde chen po re btsugs/ gtsug lag khang re rer yang chos gzhi du ma yod pa byas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags su/ bram ze de'i skyed mod tshal na nad thams cad gso bar nus pa muṣ+ti ha ri ta ka zhes bya ba a ru ra'i khyad par zhig gi sdong po yod pas skye bo mang po la phan pa zhig las/ lan cig shing gi sdong po shin tu bskams par gyur pa la slob dpon gyis sos par smon lam btab pas zhag bdun na sor chud do/ /de ltar mu stegs kyi rgol ba phal cher tshar bcad pas rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu grags shing*/ chos kyis sbrel ba'i slob mas ni phyogs thams cad khyab par yod/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge slong ni gcig kyang yongs su ma bzung*/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas bzhin du o ḍo bi sha'i nags tshal dben pa zhig tu sku 'das so/ /btsun pa dge 'dun 'bangs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma zhig ste/ yul lho phyogs pa rigs bram ze/ sde pa thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ des rdo rje'i gdan du yun ring du bzhugs shing*/ rdo rje'i gdan du 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa'i chos gzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhi btsugs/ rgyal po tu ruṣ+ka mang pos bkur bas spyan drangs te kha cher byon/

rin chen sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ kum+bha kun+ṭa li'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ theg pa chen po'i chos mang du dar bar mdzad nas yul de nyid du 'das so/ kha che'i yul du sngon theg pa chen po'i bstan pa cher med/ thogs med sku mched kyi sku ring la cung zad tsam dar/ slob dpon 'di nas brtsams te je dar du song ngo*/ /slob dpon chos 'bangs ni/ shar phyogs bhaṃ ga lar 'khrungs shing*/ thogs med sku mched gnyis kar gyi slob ma yin/ phyogs bzhi'i yul thams cad du byon nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha khang re bzhengs/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa yongs su rdzogs pa la 'grel pa mdzad do zhes grags so/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs ni/ lho phyogs tam+ba la'i yul gyi bye brag ngang pas rtse ba zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ yul de nyid du rab tu byung zhing mang du thos par mdzad pa zhig slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen kyi slob ma/ slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba las slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rnams thos par byas nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgom pas ye shes mchog brnyes/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing*/ lho phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang dan+ḍa pu ri zhes bya bar bzhugs nas chos kyang mang du bstan/ 'phags pa yab sras dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bo la sogs pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mang po la rnam bshad mdzad/ mthar ri lu'i dngos grub bsgrubs pas grub bo/ slob dpon legs ldan ni lho phyogs ma l+ya rar rgyal rigs mchog tu skye ba brnyes/ yul de nyid du rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum la mkhas par byas/ yul dbus su byon nas slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba las/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma dang klu sgrub kyi man ngag nos te/ slar yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud du gshegs nas phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong bar mdzad de/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can yang bsgrubs/ lho phyogs kyi gtsug lag lnga bcu tsam gyi bdag po mdzad de chos mang du bstan/

slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs sku 'das pa'i 'og rol du des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams gzigs/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i gzhung la slob dpon snga ma'i bzhed pa de sun phyung ste/ 'grel pa mdzad cing klu sgrub kyi man ngag la brten par zhal gyis bzhes nas mdo sde 'ga' zhig la 'grel pa mdzad do/ /mthar 'dis kyang ril bu'i dngos grub bsgrubs te grub la/ 'on kyang slob dpon 'di gnyis char gyi rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor nas rig sngags 'chang gi gnas su gshegs so/ /de la slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i gzhung btsug shing*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs slob ma ha cang mang ba ma yin kyang*/ slob dpon legs ldan ni slob ma shin tu mang ba dge slong stong phrag du ma rjes su 'brang ba yin pas lugs de shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /slob dpon 'di gnyis ma byon gyi bar du theg pa chen po pa mtha' dag bstan pa gcig tu gnas pa las/ slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs gnyis ni shin tu tha dad de/ thogs med kyi lugs ni dbu ma'i lam ston pa ma yin par sems tsam kho na yin la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa ni kho bo cag gi 'di las gzhan du med do zhes mtha' gzhan 'gog par mdzad pas/ legs ldan sku 'das pa'i 'og tsam nas theg pa chen po pa'ang nang du sde gnyis su gyes nas rtsod pa byung ngo*/ /de yang slob dpon blau gros brtan pas dbu ma rtsa ba'i dgongs pa rnam rig tu 'grel ba'i rnam bshad cig mdzad la/ de'i glegs bam lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung nas legs ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyis mi 'thad par byas so/ /de dag nā len+d+rar 'ongs nas blo brtan gyi slob ma rnams dang brtsad pas/ legs ldan gyi slob ma rgyal po zhes ngo bo nyid med par smra ba rnams zer ba dang*/ tsan+d+ra go mī dang*/ zla ba grags pa'i byung tshul gyis shes so/

/bod mang po rnams sangs rgyas bskyangs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma dang*/ legs ldan sku tshe'i smad kyi slob ma yin pa dang*/ rtsod pa byas skad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs zla grags su skye ba zhes zer ba sogs rig pas dras pa'i bcos bgros tsam du snang*/ kha cig de dag bkag nas/ dpyod pa dag dag mor byas nas/ de dag slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dngos slob yin/ legs ldan gyi bsnyen rdzogs mkhan po'ang klu sgrub yin/ zla grags 'phags pa lha'i dngos slob yin zer te/ 'phags pa lha lta bu gnyis ka'i khungs su byed pa de bzhugs bzhin du/ de gnyis grub mtha' tha dad du gyes don ga la yod/ dpyod ldan yod na de 'dra la su zhig yid ches bya/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni/ yul dbus dang lho phyogs kyi mtshams 'bar ba'i phug dang nye bar 'khrungs te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi dbon po yin zhing*/ 'phags pa ku ru kul+le'i sde pa las rab tu byung*/ sde pa de'i grub mtha' la mkhas par byas pa zhig theg pa chen po la mos nas slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du byon/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan te sher phyin mdo sde rnams yongs su rdzogs par bzung nas/ man ngag ma gsan no/ /der slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba'i slob ma'i tha ma mdzad nas sher phyin gyi man ngag de la zhus so/ /slob dpon 'di bod la grags pa ltar na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phar phyin rang las mkhas pa yin zer zhing*/ rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig ni phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma yin te/ dbyig gnyen gyi zhabs kyang ma z-in/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon rtogs ni slob dpon chos 'bangs la zhus shing*/ man ngag ni legs ldan la gsan no zhes kyang zer mod kyis/ 'dir 'phags yul na grags che ba ltar na dkyus nyid de/ dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma'i tha ma lta bu yin no/

/de la slob dpon 'di nyid rjes 'brang rnams la 'di skad ces grags te/ de yang slob dpon 'di gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyis dub pa ngal gso ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam sgom mdzad pa'i tshe nyams myong khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ don la the tshom med kyang mdo gcig dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig la mi 'byor ba 'ga' re byung ste thugs mi bde ba'i tshe/ mnal lam du 'phags pa byams pas lung bstan te/ khyod wā rā ṇa sī'i gtsug lag khang du song zhig /don chen po rnyed par 'gyur ro gsungs/ nangs par der byon pas dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pas lho phyogs po ta la nas nyi khri le brgyad ma'i dpe spyan drangs te byon pa dang 'dzom/ mdo tshig rgyan dang mthun par byung bas dbugs dbyung thob bo/ /de la mdo le brgyad ma dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma'i don du bkral ba dang*/ mdo rgyan mtha' dag bsres pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa po yin la/ slob dpon 'di ma byung ba'i snga rol du de ltar med pas/ nyi khri snang bar sngon chad gzhan gyis ma myongs gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no zhes zer ro/ /mthar shar phyogs su rgyal phran zhig gi bla mar gyur/ gtsug lag khang nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam gyi bdag po mdzad de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stsal tu bton nas gsungs pas/ sher mdo nyan pa'i dge slong rang yang nyung dus su stong phrag re 'tshogs pa lo sum cu tsam gyi bar du byung ngo*/ /slob dpon 'di rgya bod gnyis su sa dang po yin zer ba dang*/ sbyor lam pa yin pas 'phags pa dngos min yang*/ 'phags pa dang nye bas de'i khongs su gtogs zer ba dang*/ so so skye bo yin mod 'phags pa grol sde zer ba'i 'phags pa ni mig gi zur te rgyal po sangs rgyas sogs byas pas sangs rgyas yin par mi 'gyur ba bzhin zer ba dang*/

dman lam sngon song gi byang sems yin zer ba sogs mang na yang*/ skyes mchog dam pa ngo mtshar can yin par rtsod par mi snang la/ de'i thugs rgyud skye 'phags ji ltar yin sus shes/ tshul ston so so skye bo mos spyod pa cig tu mngon no/ /slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen las mngon pa'i sde snod thos la yul gzhan tha dad kyi sde snod 'dzin pa du ma bsten pa/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang shin tu mdza' bshes su gyur pa/ phyogs kyi glang po la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan pa'i slob ma zhig ste/ blo gros phyogs kyi glang po dang mnyam par grags shing brgyad stong don bsdus la 'grel pa yang mdzad/ 'dis mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa la phyogs kyi glang pos kyang bsdus don mdzad do/ /slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs slob dpon dpa' bo'i mtshan du 'dod cing*/ gang dag bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa la phyogs glang gis spel mar bstod pa'i kha skong mdzad pas dpa' bo dang*/ phyogs glang phar slob tshur slob yin no zhes chos 'byung rtsom par byed pa ni lo rgyus ma dag pa thos pa'am/ dag por thos kyang ma nges pa'i rang bzo'o/ /de yang spel mar bstod pa'i nang gi phyogs glang gi gsung rnams bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa'i tshig de dang de'i mtshams sbyor ram/ don gsal byed kho na yin pas 'grel par sbyar ba yin gyi/ slob dpon de gnyis kyis rtsom res byas pa ga la yin zhes go dgos so/ /slad kyis slob dpon des lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te gtsug lag khang du ma'i mnga' bdag mdzad nas skye bo du ma la chos bstan/ drwa ba la'i yul du byon nas chos gzhi chen po lnga bcu tsam gsar du btsugs shing bstan pa yun ring du gsal bar byas te/ mthar gnod sbyin mo bsgrubs nas ri'i rgyal po me tog brgya pa zhes bya bar bzhud do/

/dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go chas po ta lar phyin pa yang 'di dag dang dus mtshungs pa'i skabs te/ yul pun+ṭa war+bha ni'i nags tshal na dge bsnyen de 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs shig grub pa'i rtags kyang phal cher byung*/ rgyal po shu bha sa ra zhes bya ba'i rmi lam du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs spyan drangs na yul 'dir 'byon pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du mu ge dang rims nad rgyun chad cing bde bar 'gyur la/ de'i don du nags tshal na gnas pa'i dge bsnyen 'di lta bu ri bo ta lar rdzongs shig ces byung bas rgyal pos dge bsnyen bos te/ mu tig gi phreng ba dang spyan 'dren pa'i yi ge gtad/ lam rgyags pa ṇa dag kyang byin pa na/ dge bsnyen gyis bsam pa/ lam bgrod dka' zhing ring bas srog gi bar chad kyang byed srid na/ 'on kyang yi dam gyi lha bzhugs pa'i sar 'gro bar bskul ba 'di'i ngag gcog pa ni cha ma yin no snyam po ta la'i lam yig thogs te song*/ mthar dha na shrī'i gling dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du sleb/ de nas po ta lar 'gro ba'i lam sa 'og cung zad brgyud nas phyin pa na/ slar sa steng nas 'gro sa yod pa ding sang ni rgya mtsho lud pas sa gzhi non te mis thar ba med gsung*/ sngon gyi dus de tsam na lam yod pas de las brgyud nas song*/ der chu bo chen po la ma thar ba na/ lam yig ltar sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas rgan mo zhig gi gru btang nas bsgral/ yang mtsho gcig la ma thar ba na/ khro gnyer can ma la gsol ba btab pas bu mo zhig gis gzings btang nas bsgral/ yang nags kyi mtha' me 'bar nas ma thar ba la/ rta mgrin la gsol ba btab pas char phab ste zhi/ 'brug sgras lam bstan/ yang ngam grog gting dpag tshad mang po yod pas lam bcad de 'gro ma thub pa la/ ral gcig ma la gsol ba btab pas sbrul chen pos zam pa byas te de la phyin/ de nas spre'u glang po che'i lus tsam mang pos lam bkag nas 'dug pa la/

don yod zhags pa la gsol ba btab pas spre'u chen po de rnams kyis lam phye zhing bza' bca' bzang po dag byin/ de nas ri bo ta la'i rtsa bar sleb nas brag ri la ma thar te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pas spa thag gi skas byung nas de la 'dzegs/ de nas phyogs thams cad rmugs pas non te lam ma rnyed/ yun ring du gsol ba btab pa na na bun dengs/ ri de'i sum cha la sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang*/ ri sked na khro gnyer can ma'i sku brnyan sogs mthong*/ ri'i rtse mor phyin pa na gzhal med khang stong pa na me tog tho re ba las gzhan su yang mi 'dug go /der phyogs gcig tu gsol ba 'debs kyin zla ba gcig tu bsdad pas/ nam zhig na bud med cig 'ongs nas 'phags pa byon pas 'dir shog cig zer te khrid nas pho brang gi sgo rim pa stong phye ba las/ sgo re re phye bas ting nge 'dzin re re skyes/ 'phags pa lha lnga dang dngos su mjal/ me tog sku la gtor/ rgyal po'i yi ge dang rten phul/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te dge bsnyen la lam rgyags pa ṇa mang po gnang*/ 'di tsam gyi 'tsho ba la brten nas khyod yul du sleb par 'gyur gyis pa ṇa ma zad pa na 'ong ngo*/ /zhes gsungs shing lam bstan/ ri sked dang ri'i rtsa ba'i sum cha na yod pa'i sku brnyan tsho yang sku dngos su mthong*/ tshur 'ongs pa na zhag bco lnga na rang gi gnas der sleb rgyu'i bcu bzhi song ba'i nyin mo puṇ+ḍa war+dha na'i ri mthong bas rab tu dga' ste/ pa ṇa lhag pos bza' btung lhag par nyos te zos/ rgyal po'i grong khyer du ma sleb par rang gi sgrub gnas dang nye bar sleb pa'i tshe pa ṇa zad/ sa der bsdad nas nyin rangs par 'phags pa 'byon nam sems pa las ma byon/ nam phyed na gnyid du phri song ba na rol mo'i sgra grags pas gnyid sad/ nam mkha' na lha rnams mchod pa byed kyin 'dug

su la mchod dris pas 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i khye'u rmongs pa khyed nyid rgyab brten pa'i shing la 'phags pa 'khor bcas byon no zer/ bltas pas shing gi ngos la lha lnga dngos su byon 'dug pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab/ rgyal po'i yul du 'byon par zhus kyang dang po pa ṇa ma zad na de ltar yin yang da ni 'di kho nar gnas so gsung*/ de nas rgyal po la sbran pas ma mgu bar dge bsnyen la gla rngan gcig kyang ma byin skad/ de nas nags tshal der lha khang bzhengs/ kha sar+pa ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du grags te/ kha sar+pa ṇa ni nam mkha' la gshegs nas byon pa'i phyir mkha' spyod dam pa ṇa zad pa'i tshe byon pas pa ṇa zad pa zhes bya ba yin zer yang mkha' spyod du bsgyur ba ni shin tu legs shing*/ cig shos dang mthun par bsgyur na/ khar sa ni zas kyi rin gyi skad dod yin la/ pa ṇa ni gser dngul gyi dong tse da lta ṭang khar grags pa 'di yin pas/ zas rin dong tse'i don yin no/ /de ltar ni rgya gar spyi khyab tu grags pa ltar ro/ /nyi khri le brgyad ma'i lo rgyus ltar na/ rgyal pos bskul pa'i 'phros med par po ta lar lan gsum byon pa'i dang po khong rang nyid kyi mjal ba'i don dang*/ gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang mdo ma mthun pa'i dogs gcod la wā rā ṇa sī'i dge 'dun gyis btang ba yin na'ang*/ de ma zhus par 'phags pa kha sar+pa ṇa nyid spyan drangs/ kha sar+pa ṇa la zhus pas/ nga sprul pa yin pas mi shes gsungs nas/ lan gsum pa de'i dogs gcod la po ta lar byon nas le brgyad ma yang spyan drangs zer ro/ /dge bsnyen de la 'phags pa kha sar+pa ṇa lha lnga dngos su snang zhing*/ dus der mchod pa yang mngon sum du bzhes pa las/ dge bsnyen de yo byad la bltas nas chom rkun pas bkrong par brtsams pa'i tshe/ myong bar nges pa'i las kyi mthur shes nas/ mgo bo 'phags pa'i phyag tu phul zhig byas nas/ chom rkun pas kyang de bzhin du byas/

'phags pas spyan chab phyung ba klad khung du song bas de thams cad ring bsrel du gyur/ de phyin chad mchod pa dngos su ma bzhes zhes grags so/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po la sogs pa'i dus kyi gtam ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyal po shrī har+sha'i bu rgyal po ngang tshul zhes bya ba byung*/ de ni sngon dge slong sde snod gsum pa zhig rgyal po'i pho brang du dus ston chen po yod pa zhig la slong mor phyin yang bsod snyoms ma thob par sgo bas bskrad do/ /de kha zas bcad pas bkres nas 'das pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i rgyal por gyur nas rab tu byung ba rnams zas kyis tshim par byed pa'i smon lam btab/ de'i mthus rgyal pau'i longs spyod chen por gyur te phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad la kha zas bzang pos mchod pa zhig byung*/ pho brang grong khyer la ta zhes bya bar byas/ lo brgya dang bzhi bcu thob/ rgyal srid kyang lo brgyar nye bar byas so/ /yon tan 'od kyi sku tshe'i gzhug tsam na 'di rgyal sar thon/ shar du rgyal pau li tsa bī'i rigs las byung ba seng ge zhes bya ba mnga' thang chen po zhig byung*/ de'i dus slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī 'khrungs/ seng ge'i bu rgyal po bhar+sha zhes bya bas kyang rgyal srid ring du byas/ tsan+d+ra'i rigs rgyal pau sing nga tsan+d+ra zhes pa rgyal srid la 'khod de/ shugs chung ngur yod pas rgyal po seng ge dang*/ ghar+sha'i lung len dgos par byung*/ 'di skabs legs ldan dang*/ 'phags pa grol sde'i sku tshe'i smad kyi dus yin/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa dang*/ grol sde'i slob ma mchog sde dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bud+dhi'i sku tshe'i smad dang*/ yon tan 'od kyi slaub ma 'phags pa zla ba'i nor bu dang*/ na len+d+ra'i mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha rnams dus mtshungs su byung zhing*/ lho phyogs su slob dpon zla ba grags pa'ang byon/

slob dpon chos skyong dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha dang*/ grub thob bi rū pa'i sku tshe'i stod kyi dus tsam mo/ /'phags pa sa ga lha yang 'di dus byung bar mngon te/ me tog phreng brgyud lo tsā ba snyel tsor shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba na/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma 'phags pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa zhes 'byung bas so/ /de'i phyir nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin min yang brtag dgos so/ /de dag las mchog sde dang*/ ka ma la bud+dhi'i lo rgyus ma thos/ zla ba'i nor bu rgyal po ngang tshul gyi bla ma yin yang gtam rgyud rgyas pa mi snang la/ nyi ma sbas pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med kyi bzhed pa gcig tu gsung zhing*/ kha che dang ma ga dhār chos gzhi chen po bcu gnyis bcu gnyis btsugs nas/ yo byad thams cad gnod sbyin rnams sbyor du 'jug go /nang pa thams cad 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i srung ba po mdzad cing*/ sgrol ma grub pa'i dge slong sngags mkhan zhig yin te/ lo rgyus gzhan du shes/ rgyal ba'i lha yang gsungs rab du ma la mkhas par byas pa'i slob dpon chen po na len+d+rar yun ring du bzhugs pa zhig ste/ rnam thar zhib mo ma thos so/ /de'i tshe byang phyogs ha sā mar sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba zhig byon te/ slob dpon dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma snyan dngags mkhan gsang ba byin dang*/ chos 'bangs kyi slob ma rat+na ma ti la sogs pa 'khor rnam pa bzhi chos bzhin spyod pa brgya stong mang po byung nas tshems mche ba la mchod par byed pa byung*/ de'i rgyun da ltar pu khang na yod do/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pa ni/ lho phyog sa man+tar sku 'khrungs nas/ chung ngu nyid nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs/ lho phyogs kyi yul de nyid du rab tu byung zhing sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas par byas/ legs ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bud+dhi la klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs dang man ngag thams cad nos/

mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen por byung nas dpal na len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum dang*/ rig pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad de sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi lugs de nyid ches dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ /der ri mor bris pa'i ba grus ma las 'o ma bzhos nas dge 'dun thams cad 'o thug gis tshim par mdzad pa dang*/ rdo'i ka ba la phyag thogs med du song zhing*/ rtsig pa la thogs med du bzhud pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma yod cing*/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po bzlog par mdzad/ mthar lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te goṅku na'i yul du mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po tshar bcad/ bram ze dang khyim bdag phal cher bstan pa la bcug nas chos gzhi chen po mang du btab/ slad kyis ma nu bhaṃ ga zhes bya ba'i ri la sngags kyi lam la brten nas dngos grub mchog thob par bzhed pas/ yun ring du bzhugs nas 'ja' lus su song bar sngags kyi slob dpon rnams 'dod de/ bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na dgung lo sum brgya bzhugs pa dang*/ rdo'i seng ge la chibs nas tu ruṣ+ka'i dmag bzlog pa'i mdzad pa khyad par can bstan par 'dod de/ phyi ma ni de ltar byung bar rung la/ snga ma ni 'ja' lus su gyur na 'chi ba med pa yin pas lo sum brgyas char yang mi bzod/ rnam smin rags pa'i sku lus kyis mi yul du de ltar bzhugs par 'dod na ni mi 'thad par mngon no/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī ni/ shar phyogs pa ren+d+rar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba'i pan+ṭi ta zhig mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa zhig dang rtsod par gyur te/ de'i ring lugs sun phyung yang rig pa ni blos rnam par brtags pa yin pas gang blo sgrin pa de rgyal bar zad kyi/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rtags mngon sum du med pas kho bo cag de mi 'dod zer ba na/ rgyal pau la sogs pa dpang por bzhag ste/ nga nyid skye ba len pa yin pas dpral par rtags thob cig byas nas/

des dpral par mtshal gyi thig le sha la thim pa zhig byas/ kha nang du mu tig bcug ste de nyid du 'das te/ de'i lus zangs kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug nas rgyal po'i rgyas btab bo/ /de rgyal rigs kyi pan+ṭi ta bi she sa ga zhes bya ba'i bur skye bar khas blangs pa bzhin de la khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas ma thag tu mtshal gyi ri mo dpral par yod pa kha nang na mu tig yod pa de byung*/ rgyal po sogs kyis sngar gyi phung po de bltas pas dpral pa'i mtshal gy-i ri mo yang byid/ mu tig gi shul har re 'dug go /der mu stegs de yang skye ba snga phyi yod par yid ches skad/ khye'u de btsas ma thag tu ma la phyag byas te/ zla ba bcur 'o brgyal bar ma gyur tam byas pas/ byis pa btsas ma thag smra ba ni ltas ngan no snyam nas kha rog 'dug byas so/ /de nas lo bdun gyi bar du cang ma smras pas lkugs pa'o snyam mo/ /der mu stegs kyi rgol ba zhig gis shin tu go dka' ba'i snyan dngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ snyan dngags de'i don gyis sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi grub mtha' 'gog pa zhig brtsams nas rgyal po dang*/ mkhas pa'i tshogs la grims so/ /der bi she sa ga'i khyim du byung ba na/ des yun ring du brtags pas sgra don ji bzhin go ba yang med na/ lan gdab pa ga la nus te/ don de sems shing khyim gyi phyi rol tu bya ba zhig la song ngo*/ /der tsan+d+ra go mī lo bdun lon pa des bltas pa na/ don shes shing lan gdab par dka' ba med de/ de'i don 'grol ba'i yig chung btab/ lan gyi tshigs bcad kyang bris so/ /phas nang du 'ongs pa na/ de ltar bris pa mthong nas/ khyim du su byung zhes tsan+d+ra go mī'i ma la dris so/ /gzhan su yang ma 'ongs te/ bu lkugs pas blta zhing bris so/ /der phas bu la dris pa na ma'i gdong la blta zhing 'dug go /mas smros shig byas pas/ 'di ni bdag gis bris pa ste rgol ba 'di bzlog pa ni dka' ba ma yin no zhes zer/

de nas nang par tsan+d+ra go mī dang*/ mu stegs kyi ston pa de brtsad pas/ tsan+d+ra go mī rgyal te bya dga' chen po thob/ des na sgra dang rtog ge la sogs pa rig gnas thun mong ba thams cad ma bslabs par rang shes su shes pa zhig byung ste/ phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab bo/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i slob dpon zhig la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga blangs/ slob dpon chen po blau gros brtan pa la mdo sde dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod phal cher lan cig nyan pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba la bka' lung nos te/ rig sngags bsgrubs pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang*/ sgrol ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ shin tu mkhas pa chen por gyur/ de nas shar phyogs su rgyal pau bhar+sha'i yul du sman dpyad dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang/ bzo'i gnas kyi bstan bcos mang du byas/ khyad par du sgra rig pa mang du bshad cing yod/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo tā rā zhes bya ba bag mar blangs shing*/ rgyal pos yul 'khor zhig kyang mkhyen/ dus lan cig de'i g.yog mos tā rā zhes 'bod kyin 'dug pas/ yi dam dang mtshan mthun pa khyim thab tu mi rung ngo snyam nas/ slob dpon nyid yul gzhan du 'gro bar brtsams pa rgyal paus shes te/ de pha'i bu mo dang lhan cig mi 'dug na sgrom du chug la gaṅga la skyur zhig ces bsgos te de bzhin du byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ gaṅga dang rgya mtsho 'phrad mtshams kyi rgya mtsho'i gling zhig la thon/ gling de 'phags mas sprul pa yin yang zer te/ tsan+d+ra dwī pa zhes bya ba tsan+d+ra go mi nyid der bzhugs pa las ming chags shing*/ da ltar yang yod de grong bdun stong tsam shong ba zhig 'dug zer/ gling der slob dpon gyis bzhugs te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang*/ sgrol ma'i sku rdo la bzhengs/

thog mar nya pa rnams kyis gtam de thos/ de nas rim gyis skye bo gzhan yang byung ste grong khyer chags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul ba las go mī'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan ni tsan+d+ra yin la/ de phyin chad nas tsan+d+ra go mir grags so/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis khyer te siṅga la'i gling du byon/ yul de ni klu nad mang du 'byung ba zhig yod pa las der 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i lha khang bzhengs pas rang zhi yul der yang bzo dang sman dpyad la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas dpag tu med pa spel te/ gling phran gyi skye bo blun po rnams la lhag par phan gtags/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyang ci rigs bshad/ yul gyi bdag po gnod sbyin las nor blangs te chos gzhi mang du btsugs/ slar yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'ongs/ bram ze mchog sred kyi lha khang na klu la sgra nyan pa'i bkod pa dang*/ klu she ṣas byas pa'i pā ṇi ba'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yang gzigs pas/ 'grel pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung ba/ don mang ba/ ma zlos pa/ tshang ba zhig dgos ba yin pa la/ klu ni rab tu rmongs te/ tshig mang ba/ don nyung ba/ zlos pa/ ma rdzogs pa'o zhes smad nas/ pa ṇi ba'i don 'grel du tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa yan lag dang bcas pa mdzad/ gzhung der/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yangs dag rdzogs/ /zhes gsung pa yang klu la zur za ba'o/ /de nas rig pa'i 'byung gnas dpal nā len+d+rar 'ongs/ de yang nā len+d+ra na mu stegs dang rtsod par bzod pa'i pan+ṭi ta rnams lcags ri'i phyi rol tu chos 'chad/ mi bzod pa rnams nang du 'chad pa las/ de'i tshe mkhan por gyur pa zla ba grags pa ni/ phyi rol tu chos 'chad cing yod pa'i sar tsan+d+ra go mī 'grengs te bzhugs pas/ rtsod par 'dod pa rnams de bzhin byed pa yin la/ de min yang na mi nyan/ yang na gus pas nyan pa yin no/ /der zla ba grags pas rtsod zla yin nam snyam nas/ khyed gang nas 'ongs byas pas/

lho phyogs nas 'ongs zer/ chos gang shes dris pas/ sgra pā ṇi pa dang*/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gsum shes byas pas/ 'di gzhung gsum las mi shes zhes tshig khengs bskyungs kyang*/ don gyis sgra rig pa dang*/ mdo dang*/ sngags thams cad shes par khas blangs pa yin pas tsan+d+ra go mī yin nam snyam ste dris pas/ 'jig rten na de ltar grags gsung*/ 'o na mkhas pa chen po thog babs su byon pa ma legs kyis/ dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byed dgos pas re zhig grong khyer du bzhud cig gsungs/ tsan+d+ra go mīs bdag dge bsnyen la dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byar ga la rung*/ zla grags na re/ 'di la thabs shig yod de 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku zhig spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ de la rnga yab g.yob cing byon cigadage 'dun gyis 'jam dpal gyi sku la bsu ba byas par 'gyur ro gsung*/ slar de ltar byas pa'i shing rta gsum las/ dbus ma la ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal bzhugs/ g.yas na zla grags kyis rnga yab g.yob/ g.yon na tsan+d+ra go mīs rnga yab g.yob/ mdun nas dge 'dun gyis bsus/ skye bo dpag tu med pa blta ba'i phyir 'ongs/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī la sku brnyan de 'jam dbyangs dngos su snang ste/ 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs ba bye ba rnams kyis bstod par gyur mod de lta na'ang*/ zhes sogs bstod pa na/ 'jam dpal gyi sku brnyan zhal phyir log gis bstan nas gsan pa byung bas skye bo rnams kyis sku gzugs pha gi 'di ltar byed do byas pas de kha la lus te 'phags pa 'jing yon mar grags/ der tsan+d+ra go mī dad pa'i shugs rgyas te/ shing rta 'dren byed kyi kha 'then pa ma byung bar zla grags gyis sngon du song bas 'di ni nga rgyal che ste/ bdag gis rtsod par bya'o zhes zla grags kyis dgos so/ /der tsan+d+ra go mīs thogs med kyi srol la brten te rnam rig gi phyogs bzung*/

zla grags ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkral ba la brten te ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i phyogs bzung*/ lo bdun gyi bar du bgro gleng gi brgal brtag mdzad do/ /rtsod pa de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtag tu 'dus pas/ grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam rig nas/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung*/ /la la'i sman la la la'i dug/mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung*/ /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ /ces glur len no/ /de nas rtsod pa de zhir nye ba'i skabs shig na/ tsan+d+ra go mī 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig na bzhugs kyin yod de/ zla grags kyis de ring rtsod pa mang bo bkod pa'i lan/ do nub 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la zhus te nangs par lan btab pa na/ zla grags kyis de la lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de 'dra zla ba mang po song ba na/ zla grags kyis dgongs pa/ 'di la rtsod pa slob pa zhig yod do bsams nas/ tsan+d+ra go mī'i phyi bzhin song bas de lha khang du song*/ sgo'i phyi nas nyan pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku des tsan+d+ra go mī la chos gsungs te/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la ston pa bzhin du rig pa slob pa las/ zla ba grags ba'i 'phags pa la nye ring mi mnga' 'am zhes sgo phye bas de nyid du rdo skur gyur te/ chos slob bzhin pa'i phyag sor ker re pa la lus pas 'phags pa 'dzub ker mar grags/ de skabs nas rtsod pa rang zhi/ zla grags kyis spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mnal lam du khyod ni 'jam dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pas ngas byin gyis rlob mi dgos kyis/ tsan+d+ra go mī la cung zad cig byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsung*/ spyi khyab tu de tsam zhig grags la/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba rnams na re/ slar yang zhal ston par gsol ba btab pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa sgoms gsungs/

zhag bdun bsgoms pas dkyil 'khor gyi nub kyi sgo'i nang na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i phung po ltar dmar grong nger zhal gzigs skad/ de nas na len+d+ra'i gnas der bzhugs nas chos mang du bskul/ zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba tshigs bcad legs po zhig gzigs pas rang gis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo sdeb mi legs par mkhyen nas/ 'gro don mi 'byung snyam nas des khron par bskyur bas/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas/ khyod kyi 'di ni gzhan phan gyi sems bzang pos byas pas ma 'ongs pa na sems can la shin tu phan par 'gyur la/ zla grags kyis ni mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis non pas/ gzhan la phan thogs chung ngur 'gyur

ro/ /de'i phyir glegs bam khron pa nas phyung zhig /ces lung bstan pa ltar blangs te/ khron pa de'i chu 'thungs pa tsam gyis shes rab chen por 'gyur ba byung*/ tsan+d+ra pa ni de nas da lta'i bar du shin tu dar rgyas che zhing*/ phyi nang thams cad slob par byed la/ kun tu bzang po ni mi ring bar nub ste da ltar dpe tsam yang yod par mi mngon no/ /der bzo'i gnas brgya rtsa dang*/ sgra dang*/ rtog ge dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ zlos gar dang*/ mngon brjod dang*/ snyan dngags dang*/ skar rtsis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ slob ma rnams la de rnams gtso bor bshad pa'i tshe/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sa bcu pa dang zla ba sgron me dang*/ /sdong pos brgyan pa dang ni lang kar 'jug /rgyal ba rnams kyi yum gyur klogs shig kye/ /sdeb sbyor ngan g.yo'i sbyor bas khyod la ci/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas rnams nyung ngur bstan zhing*/ rmad du byung ba'i mdo lnga po de dag dus rtag tu ma chad par gzhan la gsungs/ bdag nyid kyang nyin rer zhal 'don mdzad/ mdo de rnams la don bsdu'i bstan bcos re yang mdzad/ spyir snga phyir mdzad pa la bstod pa brgya dang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ phyi rol kyi bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad de/ phra mo thor bu pa bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis brtsams zer/ pra dī ba mā li zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i lam rim mtha' dag ston pa zhig kyang mdzad de/ cher ma dar/ 'gro lding dang*/ siṅga la'i gling na de 'chad pa'i srol da lta'ang 'dug gsung*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ sku gsum la 'jug pa ni/ theg chen pan+ṭi ta phyis byon pa thams cad kyis slob mar byed pa byung ngo*/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa bod du 'gyur snang bas/

spyir bstan bcos mang po rang zhig mdzad par snang ngo*/ /yang bud med dbul mo rgan mo zhig la bu mo gzugs mdzes pa zhig yod pa/ bag mar rdzong ba'i chas med nas yul sna tshogs su slong mo la phyin/ nā len+d+rar 'ongs nas/ zla ba grags pa 'du ba rgya chen por grags pa la bslangs pas/ kho bo ni dge slong yin pas yo byad mang po ma bzung zhing*/ /cung zad yod pa'ang lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi don du dgos/ khang pa pha gi na tsan+d+ra go mī yod pas/ der slongs shig ces bstan pas/ rgan mos tsan+d+ra go mī'i sar slong du phyin na/ sku la gsol ba'i na bza' phrugs gcig dang*/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i po ti gcig las gzhan gang yang med de/ der logs bris la sgrol ma'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa dbul phongs la rab tu brtse ba'i sems kyis de la gsol ba btab cing spyan chab phyung bas/ de nyid sgrol ma dngos su gyur te/ sku'i rgyan rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa rin thang med pa'i nor bu dang bcas pa dag phud nas slob dpon la gnang*/ des kyang de la stsal bas shin tu tshim pa thob cing*/ ri mo'i sku brnyan rgyan med par song bas sgrol ma rgyan med ma zhes grags shing*/ rgyan phud pa'i shul lam me yod do/ /de ltar sems can gyi don yun ring du mdzad nas/ mthar po ta lar gshegs par bzhed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dha na shri'i gling du byon pa na/ sngon klu she ṣa la smad pas 'khon du bzung nas rgya mtsho'i rlabs chen pos gru gzings gzhug par brtsams/ rgya mtsho'i dbus nas sgra byung nas tsan+d+ra go mi phyung zhing zer/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags ma gtso 'khor lnga mkha' lding la chibs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pas klu rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas thos/ gru dha na shrīr bde bar sleb bo/ /der dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la mchod cing*/ sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/

ri po ta lar gshegs nas da lta yang lus ma spangs par bzhugs so/ /slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin yig ni/ rgyal pau'i bu rin chen grags pa zhes bya ba rab tu byung ba babs pa zhig la po ta la nas tshong pa rnams la bskur bas/ de yang slob springs mthong nas chos bzhin spyod par gyur to zhes grags so/ /de ltar byon pa las/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang*/ tsan+d+ra go mī'i sku tshe'i stod kyi dus ni/ rgyal pau seng ge dang bhar+ṣas rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus yin la/ chos skyong gi yang sku tshe'i stod yin par shes so/ /zla grags tsan+d+ra go mi na len+d+rar zhal 'dzom pa sogs sku tshe'i smad kyi dus dang*/ slob dpon chos skyong 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus ni/ rgyal bo seng ge lnga pa'i dus yin no/ /rgyal po ngang tshul gyi dus kyi gtam ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //rgyal po bhar+ṣa dang*/ singha tsan+d+ra 'das pa tsam gyi dus na/ nub phyogs ma la war rgyal pau g.yo ba zhes bya ba stobs chen po byung ste/ rgyal po ngang tshul la bdo ba tsam du gyur zhing*/ des lo sum cu rgyal srid byas te/ rgyal po ngang tshul dang dus gcig tu shi'o/ /shar phyogs su bhar+ṣa'i bu rgyal pau seng ge lnga pa zhes bya ba shin tu stobs che ba byung ste/ singha tsan+d+ra'i bu rgyal pau bā la tsan+d+ra bhaṃ ga la nas yul bton te ti rā hu tir rgyal srid byas so/ /rgyal pau seng ge lnga pa des byang bod/ lho tri liṅga/ nub tu wā rā ṇa sī/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho la thug par dbang bsgyur/ de'i tshe mchog sde'i slob ma dul ba'i sde dang*/ ma ga dhā ra btsun pa grol sde dang*/ yon tan 'od kyi slob ma mngon pa ba yon tan blo gros dang*/ slob dpon chos skyong dang*/ dbang phyug sde dang*/ kha che'i yul du thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ ma ga dhar rgyal po bhar+ṣa'i bu chung ba rgyal po gsal ba zhes bya ba yul 'khor rgya chung yang longs spyod shin tu che ba dang bcas pa byung zhing*/
